en: The reference implementation of the S3 API; every tool supports it first
Broadest storage-class ladder (Express One Zone to Glacier Deep Archive)
Deep integration with the AWS ecosystem (Lambda, Athena, EMR, Bedrock)
Managed Iceberg (S3 Tables) and native vectors (S3 Vectors)
Strong read-after-write consistency since December 2020

最も広いストレージクラス階層 (Express One Zone から Glacier Deep Archive まで)
AWS エコシステム (Lambda / Athena / EMR / Bedrock) との深い統合
マネージド Iceberg (S3 Tables) とネイティブベクトル (S3 Vectors)

en: Internet egress of $0.09/GB dominates bills for distribution workloads
Request charges and many small line items make costs hard to predict
List price for hot storage is 2-3x the alt-cloud providers

リクエスト課金や細かい課金項目が多く、コスト予測が難しい
ホット層の定価は alt-cloud 勢の 2〜3 倍

bestFor.ja: コンピュートが AWS 上にあるワークロード、データレイク/レイクハウス、フル機能とコンプライアンス網羅性が必要なもの全般

Dual-region and multi-region buckets with a single namespace
Tight integration with BigQuery / BigLake and Vertex AI
Autoclass automatic tiering

bestFor.en: Analytics and AI workloads centred on BigQuery or Vertex AI, and teams wanting simple multi-region buckets

Always Free: 100 GB/month egress from North America.

bestFor.en: Microsoft-centric enterprises, Fabric / Synapse / Databricks on Azure analytics
